reason: Checked against the source. (a) take_off begins LDA need,X / BPL out / RTS; need is zero page (&001F), so the inline test is 2+2 bytes and the BPL path keeps X, Y and the LDY ren_k / BNE taking_off that follows, which reads no A or flags. (b) buf_ss/crtc/vl/vr are read only by buffer_to_view (called only with X=2) and at render.6502:395-396 (slot 2); no tool reads them (only pccats.py names the routines), so view_to_buffer(back)'s stores are dead, and X=back is still loaded. Skipping buffer_to_view(2) when pending_n=0 is safe: between render's view_to_buffer(2) (line 348) and here nothing writes &00/&01/&B0-&B3/&BA/&BB. I grepped every STA/STX/STY/STZ/INC/DEC to those names and addresses: render, sky*, kindcache*, scroll_hazel, shield and render_zp write them only in buffer/history_to_view and restore_game_zp. prebuild's writes come before line 348 and are undone there. game.6502's are the logic's scroll and reset, which a render never calls. The irq handler does not touch them. So render_zp's reliance (&B2/&B3/&BA/&BB put back by buffer_to_view) still holds, and flip_crtc_lo and render_to_main read the same values. (c) LSR/EOR #1/TAY maps 1->1 and 2->0. This needs pending_n in {1,2}: history has two slots, one push per pass and one render per pass (render_to_main included), which is the design's '0, 1 or 2'. The zone code at 373-381 makes the same assumption. Layout: worked from the current listing. The net change is -2, padded by SKIP 2 after the BRA, so .scrolled+LDX back ends at &9323 as before. BEQ scrolled still crosses a page (+1, as before) and BRA apply_entries still crosses (as before). BNE taking_off, BPL toff_skip_f and BNE view_restore_f do not cross. No generated source, no PROTECTED line, no raster-timed code. ROMSEL, ANDY and ACCCON are the same as the old code's, and it touches the same RAM. Front end, helicopter, game over and completion paths go through the same render.
